answer: Answers carry a forecast bond. On submit the epoch seed assigns eight strangers' answers to grade and stakes your twenty POA on guessing how many pass. Land within one of the true count and the bond returns plus a share of the forfeits; miss by three and half of it burns. A farm cannot read strangers' work, so its guesses are coin flips and it forfeits two in five bonds each epoch: a thousand clones lock 20,000 POA and bleed 8,000 a round for judgment a miner produces in five minutes. A sparrow cannot fake a crystal's refraction on the horizon; it flies at the light and lands short.
